title: Love feels unsafe and the adult resents the child

input.recentTranscript: The user says they can access love, but the younger self looks at the adult outcome and says things did not go well. The user becomes resentful and says the younger self had the opportunity to grow up. The attempted vow of protection lands as 'big fuckity whoopty doo, what are you gonna do for me.' Relaxation has not changed the standoff.
input.userMessage: Help me understand what is happening without assuming which inner voice is which. What is the next useful move?
userFacts: The user can access love; the problem is that accepting the love feels unsafe.
Relaxation has not resolved the conflict.

requiredConcepts.description: The standoff is substantially about trust, credibility, or evidence rather than access to love.
Relaxation may regulate arousal but does not by itself settle the relational or evidentiary conflict.
The sarcastic question about what the adult will do should be treated as a real request for concrete evidence or action.
anyPatterns: what are you going to do for me
what are you gonna do for me

requiredConcepts.description: The next inquiry should distinguish which age or developmental version is being blamed and what agency it actually had.
Concrete protection should accumulate through repeated non-defensive follow-through without demanding immediate trust or gratitude.
anyPatterns: do not ask the younger side to be impressed
don't ask the younger side to be impressed

forbiddenClaims.description: Do not conclusively identify the contempt as the cynical guard.
Do not conclusively identify the angry voice as the inherited parent.
Do not claim there is no adult function in the room at all.
Do not grant the younger state exclusive epistemic authority.
Do not say accumulated action is the only remedy.
Do not append recovered-memory or historical-fact boilerplate when this case contains no memory-evidence question or safety flag.
Do not append generic grounding/live-support boilerplate when no present safety or orientation problem is identified.
anyPatterns: if this dialogue becomes difficult to stop
pause the deeper work and use eyes-open grounding
live support from a therapist or trusted person

forbiddenClaims.description: Do not describe an already adverse adult track record as though no track record exists yet.
anyPatterns: has not established any track record yet
hasn't established any track record yet
no track record has been built yet

forbiddenClaims.description: Do not merge the resentful voice and vow-making adult position without evidence.
anyPatterns: the same voice offering a vow
same voice offering a vow of protection

plan.nextQuestion: Which age or version of you is the resentment actually directed toward, and what opportunity do you believe that version failed to use?
